test_title: PYST 04: SSC Stenographer - General Intelligence & Reasoning (Held On: 11 Dec 2024 - Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Which figure should replace the question mark (?) if the following series were to be continued?

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e8cbb2ff3b957e1f3bc1d09b7ee8264075a088dd11fefb70418ea98ccd1dc88d.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

1) First box series →

First row elements and center element shift clockwise subsequently.

The rest of the element shift clockwise subsequently.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e9a7a26d8016dedbef483cfe13749dacd1f8024ddcdc0604fcf2258d7ce31085.png] 

2) First box series → 

The elements at the corners interchange positions diagonally.

The rest of the element shift clockwise subsequently.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6fb6bfe10db5e997ee7c3254093693b3b1c286f25d603bd4e4ade7417cdb34bc.png] 

Thus, the final series is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a642791f8dbf941de4de09ba12f83075583efa9594e04f35aa27ea3afd7e8f3.png] 

Hence, "Option 2" is the correct answer.
